access_note: Public BSD-3-Clause code; the documented ecoinvent workflow requires a separate ecoinvent licence and input database.
description: premise is developed by the Paul Scherrer Institute, Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research and contributors to connect integrated-assessment scenarios with life-cycle inventories. It modifies selected ecoinvent electricity, heat, fuel, transport and industrial processes to reflect future technologies, efficiencies and market shares. Inputs are a licensed ecoinvent database, an IAM scenario and target year; outputs are prospective inventory databases for Brightway and other LCA tools. Geographic coverage follows scenario regions and inventory mappings. Code is free under BSD-3-Clause; ecoinvent is not included and requires its own licence. A limitation is that unmapped sectors remain unchanged, and results depend on the chosen IAM, scenario, year and database version. premise can compare environmental impacts of infrastructure transitions. Brightway (platform-brightway-lca) and Activity Browser (platform-activity-browser) are documented companion tools. Only public documentation was read; no licensed inventory was accessed.
